llm.framework: urllib (stdlib) goi endpoint OpenAI-compatible cua Groq
llm.model_selection_rationale: README muc 9.1 gioi han model <= 10B parameters. Llama 3.1 8B co 8 ty tham so duoc cong bo cong khai nen chung minh duoc tuan thu (khac voi model dong nhu gemini-flash - khong cong bo so tham so, khong the chung minh). KHONG dung Gemini API vi tai thoi diem lam bai chi con 2 model Gemma duoc ho tro, deu vuot 10B: gemma-4-31b-it (31B) va gemma-4-26b-a4b-it (26B tong / 4B active); gemma-2-9b-it (9B) da bi Google go khoi Gemini API (loi 404).
llm.model_lifecycle_warning: Groq thong bao ngung llama-3.1-8b-instant tu 16/08/2026 (console.groq.com/docs/deprecations). Model chay binh thuong tai thoi diem nop bai. Model thay the Groq goi y la openai/gpt-oss-20b (20B) - VUOT 10B nen khong dung duoc cho bai nay. Sau 16/08/2026 dung phuong an du phong: dat LLM_PROVIDER=ollama de chay local gemma3:4b (4B).
used_by: coordinator.py (sinh dien giai case bang ngon ngu tu nhien, ghi vao trace.jsonl)
llm.note: LLM chi sinh doan dien giai ngon ngu tu nhien. Toan bo so lieu/quyet dinh nghiep vu (join du lieu, delivery variance, payment reconciliation, ap dung EC_POLICY_V2, verify schema) la code Python thuan (pandas + rule engine), khong phu thuoc do chinh xac cua model nho.

framework.orchestration: Python thuan (khong dung LangGraph/CrewAI) - ThreadPoolExecutor cho case-level parallel fan-out, ham thuan cho intra-case DAG
framework.env_management: python-dotenv (chi doc GROQ_API_KEY tu .env; TEN MODEL khong dat trong .env ma khai bao trong llm_client.py)

architecture_summary.pattern: Case-level parallel fan-out + intra-case DAG (Customer/Order&Product song song -> Payment/Delivery -> Policy -> Verifier) + Evaluator-Optimizer (Verifier auto-trim va re-check truoc khi ghi file)

dataset.source: Kaggle - Brazilian E-Commerce Public Dataset by Olist

run_result.note: 50/50 case pass Verifier. Toan bo logic nghiep vu (join du lieu, delivery variance, payment reconciliation, policy rule, schema) da duoc kiem chung bang validator tu dong doi chieu truc tiep voi README.
